title: A drill opened from a page block shows its list compact, with no condition chips to change or remove
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Found by the contract review 7085628792 on PR #36461 (card #36256, drill-down from a dashboard or page block opens a filtered list) on 2026-11-22, graded S7 there. Filed by the seat, not claimed. Parent: #36256.

## What happens

On a dashboard, a drill opens its list with the clicked part as condition chips the user can change or remove. Inside a page block, the same drill opens the list in the page region's compact or capped posture, because `ListViewBlock` reads that posture from context. The rows are right (the condition applies, and they match the tile), but the list shows no chips, no sort and no added columns. So the user cannot see which condition is applied, and cannot change or remove it there.

## To do

1. Clear the page-region posture inside the drill dialog, so a page-block drill draws the full list with its chips, as a dashboard drill does.
2. Say where the capped posture's "View all N" link leads from a drill, and make it keep the drill's condition, or not draw it inside the dialog.
3. Pin both with a control: a page-block drill shows the chips; a page-block list outside a drill keeps its compact posture.

## Done when

A drill opened from a page block shows its condition as chips the user can change or remove, the same as a drill opened from a dashboard, and the page block's own list is drawn as before.

Blocked-by: #36461

p2 · area:ux · domain:ui (same reach as #36256).
